dialogueContent: I might starve before I die of illness...
Don't catch anything.
Bury me in the backyard, where my roses grow.
Great! I'll come here again for treatment next time!
It's been a long time since I had fresh food.
Every breath feels like burning coals in my lungs.
This torment worse than death is more terrifying than an inferno.
I can train the mightiest warrior!
I'm the best lumberjack in town. Reach out if you need help!
I used to be an adventurer until I took an arrow to the knee...
The medicine I took just now was so bitter, even more than my life.
The Black Rat is terrifying.
Time to deal with those Black Rats!
So many patients.
I miss the old days.
I will keep living until I see all the Black Rats eliminated!
I hear the Black Rats waiting to feast on my corpse.
The nobles hide in the castle while we suffer outside!
Move aside, I'm going to throw up.
This ward isn't as comfortable as my home.
A Black Rat is introducing itself. Its name is Jerry.
Someday, I want to be a doctor too!
New items have arrived. Come take a look!
When will this disaster finally end?
Black Rats! A black Rat bit me!
I would rather hang myself from the rafters than endure the plague.
Treasure your health; it won't come back.
I heard there are biting Blights outside the town, I hope I won't run into them...
Ahem... I can't get sick!
It feels great to help others.
Patient, hunger is not a disease.
I wish to return to my mother.
I don't want to be amputated!
Ugh... It's so painful...
The town was ravaged by the plague almost overnight!
Nothing is more important than health.
Can the ones in front hurry up?
Dealing with peculiar patients is more distressing than being ill.
I might starve before I die of illness...
I can construct the most beautiful house.
Thank you for your support, see you next time!
The doctor's hands pulled me back from the brink of death.
Thank the gods! Thank the doctors!
Maybe one day, I can become a plague doctor.
I'm afraid of taking medicine...
Help! Save me!
Can the ones in front hurry up?
God, please save us.
I'm feeling weak. Can you treat me first?
If I don't make it, bury me under the tree.
Something evil must be out to harm us!
I'm afraid of taking medicine...
I can finally go home, but... my family is gone.
I miss the old days.
Keep smiling.
Ahem ahem... Ahem ahem ahem...
My stomach hurts as if needles are stabbing.
No one should compete with me. I'm assisting the doctor!
Sigh, let's wait a bit longer.
Don't rush, don't push, don't die.
How much longer until it's my turn...
These people are in such a bad state. They have to be carried.
This town must be cursed!
I'm barely holding on... Can you save me first?
The people here are so nice, and they speak so well. I really don't want to leave the ward.
Have the gods abandoned us?
Fantastic! I'm still alive!
Just thinking about continuing work later makes me uncomfortable...
If I survive, I'll personally eliminate all the black rats!
These people's conditions seem quite severe.
The doctor saved me, and I want to repay them.
No available wards.
The town was ravaged by the plague almost overnight.
There are monsters outside the town, so many monsters!
Why has this disaster befallen us...
The herbal scent is strong.
I feel no pain, fantastic!
Ahem, Ahem... Can you hurry up...
Demons are devouring my insides! I'm in agony!
My family must be worried, I need to hurry home.
Why do they get priority?
Much more comfortable!
Being cautious won't hurt.
Is anyone available for consultation?
Studying herbs is my specialty.
Finally, it's almost my turn.
Can you hurry up?
Ahem... Ahem... I feel terrible...
Is it a curse? My whole body is rotting!
I can't hold on... Ahem, ahem...
I don't want to end up on a stretcher.
My stomach hurts as if needles are stabbing.
Let those with severe conditions be treated first.
Oh no, I don't want to end up like that!
If there are gods, why do they not save us?
I can hold on a little longer.
I might starve before I die of illness...
Hope everyone recovers quickly.
If you need brewing, I'm the one to find.
Is there anything I can assist with?
Whenever there's a need, I'll offer my full support.
Let me see what I can do to help...
Patient, please refrain from vomiting on the table!
Ahem ahem... Ahem ahem ahem...
I'm afraid of taking medicine...
My eyes are about to pop out of their sockets!
Can the ones in front hurry up?
It hurts... It hurts so much!
Medicine is in short supply. Please wait for restocking.
Keep things clean!
I'm the most renowned stableman nearby!
I can help care for patients!
I miss the old days.
When can I finally rest...
Patient, please refrain from wandering in the corridor.
I also want to become a doctor and save lives.
I heard there are biting Blights outside the town, I hope I won't run into them...
How much longer until it's my turn...
I really want a sip of clean spring water.
Incredible!
Please, save my family too.
Help me cleanse my festering skin with holy water...
Ahem ahem... Ahem ahem ahem...
I saw Blights! Blight!
Miracle healer! Truly a miracle healer!
It's the Black Wizard... He's here for revenge.
Black Wizard! I curse you to be plagued in return!
The squeaking of the Black Rat kept me awake all night
They claim bloodletting cures illness, yet my blood grows darker.
My daughter... Is she still alive?
I don't want to die yet...
Don't throw me into the mass grave. I'm still alive!
How much longer until it's my turn...
I'm feeling capable again!
Black Rats gnawing on corpses by the roadside—it's like...
I feel like decaying flesh melting away.
My family was all killed by the Blight...
Will they survive?
Am I dead... Are you angels...
The herbal scent is strong.
